findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "answer_from_library" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: The answer format for anything the user could pick up and use. ALWAYS use this — not generate_document, not prose, not a web search — for a question about WHAT …

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_session" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: design_status, refine_session, get_session, session_one_pager, generate_document · Private data: design_session, session_one_pager, generate_document, generate_worksheet, generate_canvas · Public sink: design_session, session_one_pager, generate_document, share_session, add_debrief, generate_cards · Destructive: find_session_format, answer_from_library, search_methods, design_session, refine_session, add_debrief, generate_worksheet, generate_canvas.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: design_status, refine_session, get_session, session_one_pager, generate_document · Private data: design_session, session_one_pager, generate_document, generate_worksheet, generate_canvas · Public sink: design_session, session_one_pager, generate_document, share_session, add_debrief, generate_cards · Destructive: find_session_format, answer_from_library, search_methods, design_session, refine_session, add_debrief, generate_worksheet, generate_canvas

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
